brief:
Fergie Chambers, an activist, has been targeted by the United States for providing support to humanitarian organizations operating in Palestine, according to The Chris Hedges Report. Chambers described the action as part of a broader pattern of suppressing advocacy for Palestinians and characterized the personal cost of maintaining opposition to what she describes as genocide.

The targeting of Chambers reflects escalating efforts to criminalize solidarity with Palestinian causes, particularly through connections to aid organizations. She emphasized the stakes involved in continued activism and the pressure faced by those who publicly support humanitarian work in Palestinian territories.
dek: Fergie Chambers speaks out about being targeted by the United States for supporting humanitarian organizations in Palestine and the high cost of fulfilling our obligation to oppose genocide.
title: U.S. targets activist for supporting Palestinian humanitarian organizations
